summary: root.go must register the hand-authored sync/get/searches commands, and sync hints must stay enabled; a plain regen of root.go silently drops all four because the generator does not know these commands exist.
reason: The generator owns root.go but does not own this CLI's hand-written local-store layer, so a regen rewrites the AddCommand block from the spec alone and orphans sync.go/get.go/searches.go — the files stay in the tree and still compile, so nothing fails loudly, but the entire advertised sync -> stats/skills/new workflow becomes unreachable at runtime. The same regen left syncHintsEnabled false while the generated sync_hint tests assert the enabled behavior. Any future regen must re-apply this wiring.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli/ went from 6 failures (TestNovelSyncHelpWires plus 5 sync_hint tests) to green; sync, get, and searches now appear in --help and execute their real code paths.
